reasons.dependency-missing: A required local runtime is unavailable.
reasons.dependency-version-unavailable: A runtime version could not be verified.

review-runtime-installation.text: Review the local runtime installation and run the explicit feature installer.

reasons.configuration-invalid: Client configuration could not be validated.
reasons.owned-hook-duplicate: A managed hook appears more than once.
reasons.validator-unavailable: The client configuration validator is unavailable.

review-client-configuration.text: Review the client configuration and rerun the startup-health installer.

reasons.token-meter-hook-missing: The token-meter hook is missing or drifted.
reasons.token-meter-data-denied: The token-meter data directory is not writable by the current user.
reasons.token-meter-manifest-invalid: The token-meter install manifest is invalid.

run-token-meter-installer.text: Run the Token Meter installer after reviewing the reported drift.

reasons.notification-component-missing: A Feishu notification component is missing.
reasons.notification-hook-missing: The Feishu notification hook is missing or drifted.
reasons.bootstrap-task-missing: The Feishu notification bootstrap task is missing.
reasons.bootstrap-task-disabled: The Feishu notification bootstrap task is disabled.
reasons.bootstrap-last-run-failed: The Feishu notification bootstrap last completed with an error.

run-notification-installer.text: Run the explicit Feishu notification bootstrap installer.

reasons.live-gateway-external-to-task: A validated gateway is running outside the scheduled task.
reasons.gateway-not-running: The Feishu remote gateway is not running.
reasons.gateway-health-invalid: The Feishu remote gateway health document is invalid.
reasons.gateway-health-stale: The Feishu remote gateway health document is stale.
reasons.gateway-start-timeout: The Feishu remote gateway did not become ready in time.
reasons.gateway-task-exited: The Feishu remote gateway task exited before becoming ready.
reasons.gateway-task-disabled: The Feishu remote gateway task is disabled.
reasons.gateway-task-missing: The Feishu remote gateway task is missing.
reasons.policy-task-definition-drift: Gateway task definition no longer matches the approved auto-start policy.

reinstall-health-policy.text: Re-run the startup-health installer after reviewing the gateway task change.

run-gateway-installer.text: Run the explicit Feishu gateway installer.

reasons.chrome-devtools-package-missing: The pinned Chrome DevTools MCP package is unavailable.
reasons.chrome-devtools-config-missing: Chrome DevTools MCP is not configured for this client.
reasons.chrome-devtools-config-drift: Chrome DevTools MCP configuration differs from the pinned installation.
reasons.chrome-unavailable: Chrome is unavailable for automatic connection.

review-chrome-devtools-setup.text: Review the Chrome DevTools MCP and Chrome remote-debugging setup.

reasons.model-proxy-ready: The configured local model proxy is reachable.
reasons.model-proxy-unconfigured: No local model proxy endpoint is configured.
reasons.model-proxy-unreachable: The configured local model proxy is unavailable.
reasons.model-proxy-not-loopback: The configured model proxy is not a loopback endpoint.

review-model-proxy.text: Review the local model proxy service and client endpoint configuration.
